title: Speakeasy AI Control Plane metadata extensions

com.speakeasy.ai/registry.description: Backend-owned first recorded publication. Historical publication dates may be unknown.

com.speakeasy.ai/catalog.description: Staff-maintained catalog metadata, visible to all authenticated registry consumers. Never include secrets.

documentationUrl.description: Public documentation URL. HTTP and HTTPS are supported; HTTPS is recommended. Never include secrets.

supportsDcr.description: Staff-curated record of whether the server's authorization server publishes an OAuth dynamic client registration endpoint. Informational for consumers that build an install flow from this record, such as Okta server suggestions, which default to per-user OAuth when true. Catalog listings compute their own value from discovery and do not read this. Absent means false.

com.speakeasy.ai/okta.description: Staff-maintained mapping from Okta Integration Network (OIN) applications to this server. Drives MCP server suggestions and Cross App Access prefill for organizations that sync their Okta applications. Closed object: new fields need a server deploy first. Public vendor catalog data only; never include tenant data or secrets.

oinNames.description: Okta application `name` values (the OIN key) served by this entry, matched exactly against synced Okta apps. Catalog apps use the bare key (`linear`); integrator-published apps use `integrator-<integration id>_<key>_<n>`. Each key may map to one catalog entry across the whole catalog.

oinIntegrationId.description: Numeric OIN integration id shared by every instance of the integration.

xaaSignOnModes.description: Okta sign-on modes of this integration that support Cross App Access. Omit when unknown; consumers then assume both SAML_2_0 and OPENID_CONNECT. App instances with other modes (SWA, bookmark) are flagged as the wrong kind.

xaaIssuer.description: Vendor Issuer URL entered in Okta's Cross App Access setup for this integration. HTTPS, host, optional path; no query, fragment or userinfo.
